sources.snippet: Reproducible implementation of the VoNet paper (ICCIP 2016) for 5-class vehicle orientation classification: front, rear, side, front-side, rear-side. Original implementation in the paper used Caffe framework. This is a revised implementation in PyTorch. The result can be slightly differ from what stated in the paper.
